title: V01-C16 Functional Decomposition and Reuse Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: A multi-step problem converted into a responsibility and function map; two valid decomposition alternatives compared using cohesion, dependency inventory, change scenarios, and independent tests; and an orchestrated implementation with explicit contracts and preserved behavior.

accessibility_requirements: Function maps include numbered textual traversal.
Dependency graphs label direction and data contract.
Comparison tables do not rely on color-only ratings.
Turkish terms include English only at first meaningful use.
Code comments and explanations are Turkish.
known_risks: Every line may be extracted into a function.
Function length may replace responsibility evidence.
Cohesion may be treated as subjective neatness.
Coupling may be counted only as direct calls.
Shared mutable state may create false reuse.
Coincidental duplication may be abstracted prematurely.
